newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai bourse to expand off-floor bidding.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai bourse to expand off-floor bidding.

text.p: The Shanghai stock exchange will expand off-floor bidding and make off-floor transactions the major part of its trading from next month, the Shanghai Securities News said on Monday.
"The exchange will make major adjustments to its trading methods from October," the newspaper quoted an exchange spokesman as saying.
"While maintaining a certain number of trading-floor seats, the exchange will facilitate off-floor bidding and make such transactions the principal method of trading," the spokesman said.
He said the move was aimed at enlivening trading, improving the exchange's efficiency and helping its long-term development.
The exchange has conducted off-floor bidding on a trial basis over the past two months and the time is ripe to expand it, the spokesman was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
Currently only a handful of wealthy investors have the right to trade on the exchange through remote computer terminals.
